digitized.method: Fig. 3b (raster xref 141, 777×1751 px): marker centres located by colour masks + connected components on the native raster, axes from the inward tick marks; digitized S_t aligned within each state to the stated SI Table S2 values (126 of 129 located; |diff| median 0.13–0.96, max 1.72 MPa) → each stated S_t gets a digitized diameter d. Panel (a) cross-check: F_c = S_t·π·d²/2.8 agrees with the digitized F_c (median |diff| 0.08–0.20 mN). Fig. 2a (raster xref 52): loading-branch centre, run-in plateau and second loading branch read on the native raster. Details in the header of digitized.csv.
